title: Elegant Grilled Argentinian Asado
description: A rich, shaggy, one-pot argentinian dish featuring sake and grilled flavors that's anti-inflammatory-friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together sake, olive oil, garlic, oregano, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the flank steak and skirt steak to the marinade, turning to coat evenly.
Let the steaks marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the chicken thighs onto skewers, leaving a 1-inch space between each piece.
Brush the grill grates with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Remove the steaks from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Grill the steaks for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they reach your desired level of doneness.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
Transfer the cooked meats to a large cutting board, and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Thinly slice the steaks against the grain, and serve with the grilled chicken, red onion, and fresh parsley.
